title: Research on Autonomous Navigation of a Disinfection Robot for Hospital Based on ROS
authors: J. Wang; B. Zhang; H. Tang; X. Wei; J. Wang
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
